annotations.title: Estimate an AI session's footprint from token counts

description:
Estimate the water and energy of an AI session (e.g. an agent or coding-assistant run) from its token
usage. Pass the SUM across all model calls: input_tokens (uncached prompt tokens), output_tokens
(including any reasoning/thinking tokens) and cached_input_tokens (prompt-cache reads). model_class:
'small' (Haiku/mini/Flash-class), 'frontier' or 'reasoning'. Returns a central estimate and a 0.3x–3x
range – this is an order-of-magnitude estimate calibrated to published per-prompt figures, not a
measurement.

boundary.description: Accounting boundary: 'onsite' = data-centre cooling water only (as vendors report); 'comprehensive' = also counts water used to generate the electricity (the wider boundary most researchers use).
boundary.title: Boundary

cached_input_tokens.description: Prompt-cache read tokens, summed across every model call. 0 if unknown.
cached_input_tokens.title: Cached Input Tokens

input_tokens.description: Uncached input (prompt) tokens, summed across every model call in the session.
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

model_class.description: Model size: 'small' = Haiku/mini/Flash-class, 'frontier' = flagship models, 'reasoning' = extended-thinking models.
model_class.title: Model Class

output_tokens.description: Output tokens, including any reasoning/thinking tokens, summed across every model call.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
